answer_1.quote: We evaluated our approach on four datasets: DART for data-to-text generation, XSum for summarization, WMT16 EN-RO for machine translation, and Commonsense Dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We report common string-matching metrics, BLEU, METEOR, and TER, as well as popular learned metrics, BERTScore, MoverScore, and BLEURT.

answer_4.quote: We further validated f-DISTILL by human evaluation, where models were rated by fluency, missing information, and hallucination between 1 to 5 on the DART dataset, following previous work.
answer_4.guideline: models were rated by fluency, missing information, and hallucination between 1 to 5
